site: Bonita Springs Public Library, 10560 Reynolds Street
about: Holly Jolly Santa Visit is a branch program of the Lee County Library System, held at the Bonita Springs Public Library on Reynolds Street on the evening of Tuesday, December 15, 2026.
The listing sets the window at 5 to 6:30 PM, so a family can come straight after school or work and still be done before a late dinner.
The library names Santa photos, crafts and Christmas activities as the draw, and says every supply is handed out while it lasts.
No registration is required, so a family can walk in during the window instead of reserving a spot ahead of time.
The age range is birth to 11, which covers babies in arms, preschoolers and elementary school children at the same table.
Branch questions go to the Bonita Springs library at (239) 533-4860, and the system's main line for accessibility requests is 239-479-4636.
The library system says visitors may be photographed by staff during programs and that anyone who prefers to opt out is responsible for stepping out of the area or telling the photographer.
Sign language interpretation and assistive listening can be provided on request, and the system asks for at least five business days of notice.

site: East County Regional Library, 881 Gunnery Road N, Lehigh Acres
about: Winter Celebration with Santa is listed on the Lee County Library System calendar for the East County Regional Library in Lehigh Acres on Monday, December 14, 2026.
